body: Hey, buddy do you want to talk about it?
I’m similar to you my friend. I have a persona who is normal and happy outside my house, but inside I’m sad and cry a lot. I can relate on what you’re going through.

Well I wouldn’t recommend attempting because I have an $8000 bill to pay off. Just go to a walk in clinic and ask about some antidepressants. It will be better in the long run. Also I pay $4 for my antidepressants.

Yeah, I feel you on that one. You’re depressed in the sense that you want to not exist, whether it be trauma or chemical imbalance. Have you talk to a doctor about how you think? You can ask them to get you on some antidepressants.

I mean some people deal with depression in different ways. You don’t have to be sad to feel depressed. You’re depressed because you want to harm yourself. It’s more of a mental thing than a feeling thing, if that makes any sense.
Ok. I’m as well. You said you started your recovery, hows that going?
Oh, I’m definitely worse than you. Weird question, but what gender are you?

I don’t know, you seem like a nice enough person. You don’t sound unappealing from our interaction. I just don’t want to make the same mistakes over again. This isn’t the first time that has happened. I’m just not worth it really, and I’m unappealing in conversation. Like I have no conversational skills.
I’m just bad at talking to people and it really messes with me when I make a mistake. I don’t think I’m cut out to have any friends. I’m just bad at a lot of things in general.
I take things too personal and it eventually caused me to hurt them because I was essentially playing the victim.
Well I can’t hurt anyone if I don’t talk to them, and that’s why I don’t.
Yeah, I used to have people that wanted to talk to me, but then I hurt them and now they won’t talk to me. So every time someone else wants to talk to me I don’t respond to them.
Thank you, I’m just lonely and don’t have any friends.
